description: The bar chart titled “Recall@10” visually compares the performance of four different methods in terms of recall at rank 10, with the vertical axis representing recall values ranging from 0.1 to 0.4 in increments of 0.1. The horizontal axis lists the four methods: “Ours” (in orange), “- critiquing” (blue), “- scoring” (blue), and “- ranking” (blue), indicating ablation variants of the proposed method. The “Ours” method achieves the highest recall at approximately 0.35, significantly outperforming the others. The “- critiquing” variant follows with a recall of about 0.29, while “- ranking” achieves roughly 0.23, and “- scoring” performs the worst at approximately 0.16. The chart uses distinct colors to highlight the proposed method (“Ours”) in orange, while the ablated versions are uniformly colored in blue, visually emphasizing the contribution of each component to the overall performance. The bars are arranged left to right in descending order of performance, with no additional annotations or error bars present.
